units.rawText: A few days later, Outer Oasis Plaza.
units.displayText: A few days later, Outer Oasis Plaza.

spans.text: A few days later, Outer Oasis Plaza.

units.rawText: I've collated the circumstances and feedback into a report. Please have a look.
units.displayText: I've collated the circumstances and feedback into a report. Please have a look.

spans.text: I've collated the circumstances and feedback into a report. Please have a look.

units.rawText: Good work, Persicaria. It's about time for a lunch break, so you go rest. I'll be off for lunch as well.
units.displayText: Good work, Persicaria. It's about time for a lunch break, so you go rest. I'll be off for lunch as well.

spans.text: Good work, Persicaria. It's about time for a lunch break, so you go rest. I'll be off for lunch as well.

units.rawText: Of course, Professor.
units.displayText: Of course, Professor.

spans.text: Of course, Professor.

units.rawText: But... will you really be okay by yourself?
units.displayText: But... will you really be okay by yourself?

spans.text: But... will you really be okay by yourself?

units.rawText: Persicaria hesitates for a moment, then glances back and asks again.
units.displayText: Persicaria hesitates for a moment, then glances back and asks again.

spans.text: Persicaria hesitates for a moment, then glances back and asks again.

units.rawText: ...What exactly do you think Miss Bonneville is doing?
units.displayText: ...What exactly do you think Miss Bonneville is doing?

spans.text: ...What exactly do you think Miss Bonneville is doing?

units.rawText: From what I can see, she seems to be tailing me...
units.displayText: From what I can see, she seems to be tailing me...

spans.text: From what I can see, she seems to be tailing me...

units.rawText: I follow Persicaria's sight, looking at the redheaded figure not far away.
units.displayText: I follow Persicaria's sight, looking at the redheaded figure not far away.

spans.text: I follow Persicaria's sight, looking at the redheaded figure not far away.

units.rawText: She stands some dozen paces away, yawning as she spins the ends of her hair around her finger like a yarn.
units.displayText: She stands some dozen paces away, yawning as she spins the ends of her hair around her finger like a yarn.

spans.text: She stands some dozen paces away, yawning as she spins the ends of her hair around her finger like a yarn.

units.rawText: As our eyes meet, she doesn't fail to wave her hand in greeting, apparently not wanting to either approach or leave.
units.displayText: As our eyes meet, she doesn't fail to wave her hand in greeting, apparently not wanting to either approach or leave.

spans.text: As our eyes meet, she doesn't fail to wave her hand in greeting, apparently not wanting to either approach or leave.

units.rawText: No self-concealment or keeping of distance... I can't say I've ever seen anyone tail someone like this before...
units.displayText: No self-concealment or keeping of distance... I can't say I've ever seen anyone tail someone like this before...

spans.text: No self-concealment or keeping of distance... I can't say I've ever seen anyone tail someone like this before...

units.rawText: She's been like this the entire morning. It hasn't gotten in the way of work, so I've just let her be.
units.displayText: She's been like this the entire morning. It hasn't gotten in the way of work, so I've just let her be.

spans.text: She's been like this the entire morning. It hasn't gotten in the way of work, so I've just let her be.

units.rawText: Though... I do happen to have some free time. We ought to receive our guest from the Guardians properly.
units.displayText: Though... I do happen to have some free time. We ought to receive our guest from the Guardians properly.

spans.text: Though... I do happen to have some free time. We ought to receive our guest from the Guardians properly.

units.rawText: I end my call, strolling towards the person behind me.
units.displayText: I end my call, strolling towards the person behind me.

spans.text: I end my call, strolling towards the person behind me.

units.rawText: Good midday, Bonneville.
units.displayText: Good midday, Bonneville.

spans.text: Good midday, Bonneville.

units.rawText: Oh, Professor! What a coincidence seeing you here!
units.displayText: Oh, Professor! What a coincidence seeing you here!

spans.text: Oh, Professor! What a coincidence seeing you here!

units.rawText: Coincidence indeed... Bonneville, might I ask what exactly you're doing?
units.displayText: Coincidence indeed... Bonneville, might I ask what exactly you're doing?

spans.text: Coincidence indeed... Bonneville, might I ask what exactly you're doing?

units.rawText: What I'm doing... that should be obvious, no? I'm following you, of course!
units.displayText: What I'm doing... that should be obvious, no? I'm following you, of course!

spans.text: What I'm doing... that should be obvious, no? I'm following you, of course!

units.rawText: And why are you doing this?
units.displayText: And why are you doing this?

spans.text: And why are you doing this?

units.rawText: It's the first time I've ever seen a human as interesting as you, Professor. It's only natural that I'd want to observe a little.
units.displayText: It's the first time I've ever seen a human as interesting as you, Professor. It's only natural that I'd want to observe a little.

spans.text: It's the first time I've ever seen a human as interesting as you, Professor. It's only natural that I'd want to observe a little.

units.rawText: She lets go of the hair strands around her finger, leaning forward and inspecting me from head to toe.
units.displayText: She lets go of the hair strands around her finger, leaning forward and inspecting me from head to toe.

spans.text: She lets go of the hair strands around her finger, leaning forward and inspecting me from head to toe.

units.rawText: Well, have you derived any conclusions?
units.displayText: Well, have you derived any conclusions?

spans.text: Well, have you derived any conclusions?

units.rawText: Hmm... you seem fine both in spirit and body. Looks like all the effort you put into White Day didn't go to waste.
units.displayText: Hmm... you seem fine both in spirit and body. Looks like all the effort you put into White Day didn't go to waste.

spans.text: Hmm... you seem fine both in spirit and body. Looks like all the effort you put into White Day didn't go to waste.

units.rawText: I still have you to thank for that.
units.displayText: I still have you to thank for that.

spans.text: I still have you to thank for that.

units.rawText: Let me treat you to lunch as a show of gratitude.
units.displayText: Let me treat you to lunch as a show of gratitude.

spans.text: Let me treat you to lunch as a show of gratitude.

units.rawText: Sigh... I helped you in the first place as thanks for the chocolates. Now you're going to offer thanks for my thanks, and it'll go on and on.
units.displayText: Sigh... I helped you in the first place as thanks for the chocolates. Now you're going to offer thanks for my thanks, and it'll go on and on.

spans.text: Sigh... I helped you in the first place as thanks for the chocolates. Now you're going to offer thanks for my thanks, and it'll go on and on.

units.rawText: I don't think I mind that. What do you want to eat?
units.displayText: I don't think I mind that. What do you want to eat?

spans.text: I don't think I mind that. What do you want to eat?

units.rawText: Hahaha, if you put it that way, I'll leave the food up to you. As for drinks, though, it has to be canned root beer!
units.displayText: Hahaha, if you put it that way, I'll leave the food up to you. As for drinks, though, it has to be canned root beer!

spans.text: Hahaha, if you put it that way, I'll leave the food up to you. As for drinks, though, it has to be canned root beer!

units.rawText: Your tastes certainly are unique... seeing as root beer is at least non-alcoholic, that should be alright.
units.displayText: Your tastes certainly are unique... seeing as root beer is at least non-alcoholic, that should be alright.

spans.text: Your tastes certainly are unique... seeing as root beer is at least non-alcoholic, that should be alright.

units.rawText: Oh? I didn't think the Oasis actually had root beer. I couldn't find any in a day of looking.
units.displayText: Oh? I didn't think the Oasis actually had root beer. I couldn't find any in a day of looking.

spans.text: Oh? I didn't think the Oasis actually had root beer. I couldn't find any in a day of looking.

units.rawText: I will prepare it for you. Shall we go?
units.displayText: I will prepare it for you. Shall we go?

spans.text: I will prepare it for you. Shall we go?

units.rawText: I begin to walk towards our destination, but I find Bonneville press closer and closer to my face, a serious expression on her face.
units.displayText: I begin to walk towards our destination, but I find Bonneville press closer and closer to my face, a serious expression on her face.

spans.text: I begin to walk towards our destination, but I find Bonneville press closer and closer to my face, a serious expression on her face.

units.rawText: W-What is it?
units.displayText: W-What is it?

spans.text: W-What is it?

units.rawText: Dang... the Professor's way too scrupulous during the day, I can't find a single vulnerability. I'll have to sign up for a night shift.
units.displayText: Dang... the Professor's way too scrupulous during the day, I can't find a single vulnerability. I'll have to sign up for a night shift.

spans.text: Dang... the Professor's way too scrupulous during the day, I can't find a single vulnerability. I'll have to sign up for a night shift.

units.rawText: Bonneville's serious countenance is so close to my face that I can't help but break into laughter.
units.displayText: Bonneville's serious countenance is so close to my face that I can't help but break into laughter.

spans.text: Bonneville's serious countenance is so close to my face that I can't help but break into laughter.

units.rawText: When I'm working at night, you're out driving about somewhere, right?
units.displayText: When I'm working at night, you're out driving about somewhere, right?

spans.text: When I'm working at night, you're out driving about somewhere, right?

units.rawText: Wow, the Professor's grasped a secret of mine... looks like I'll have to redouble my efforts.
units.displayText: Wow, the Professor's grasped a secret of mine... looks like I'll have to redouble my efforts.

spans.text: Wow, the Professor's grasped a secret of mine... looks like I'll have to redouble my efforts.

units.rawText: Alright, let's see if I can't find a weakness while we eat!
units.displayText: Alright, let's see if I can't find a weakness while we eat!

spans.text: Alright, let's see if I can't find a weakness while we eat!

units.rawText: Bonneville quickly switches up her demeanor as she stretches while I watch on, not knowing whether to laugh or lament.
units.displayText: Bonneville quickly switches up her demeanor as she stretches while I watch on, not knowing whether to laugh or lament.

spans.text: Bonneville quickly switches up her demeanor as she stretches while I watch on, not knowing whether to laugh or lament.

units.rawText: Oh yeah, should we call Miss Shale along? You two came here together, after all. I happened to invite her out this afternoon as well.
units.displayText: Oh yeah, should we call Miss Shale along? You two came here together, after all. I happened to invite her out this afternoon as well.

spans.text: Oh yeah, should we call Miss Shale along? You two came here together, after all. I happened to invite her out this afternoon as well.

units.rawText: Ah, nah. She's got some stuff to do still.
units.displayText: Ah, nah. She's got some stuff to do still.

spans.text: Ah, nah. She's got some stuff to do still.

units.rawText: Miss Shale certainly seems busy. She's juggling communicating engineering concepts with Croque and managing logistics with Centaureissi...
units.displayText: Miss Shale certainly seems busy. She's juggling communicating engineering concepts with Croque and managing logistics with Centaureissi...

spans.text: Miss Shale certainly seems busy. She's juggling communicating engineering concepts with Croque and managing logistics with Centaureissi...

units.rawText: Are you implying that I'm not busy, Professor? I'll have you know that's not true at all, okay?
units.displayText: Are you implying that I'm not busy, Professor? I'll have you know that's not true at all, okay?

spans.text: Are you implying that I'm not busy, Professor? I'll have you know that's not true at all, okay?

units.rawText: Alright, alright. Then, the ever-busy Miss Bonneville, let's go.
units.displayText: Alright, alright. Then, the ever-busy Miss Bonneville, let's go.

spans.text: Alright, alright. Then, the ever-busy Miss Bonneville, let's go.

units.rawText: Let's go! Heheh♪ Time for some root beer~!
units.displayText: Let's go! Heheh♪ Time for some root beer~!

spans.text: Let's go! Heheh♪ Time for some root beer~!
